review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original PRD. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, the exact four-file writable binding scope, and the implementation/independent-verification task split agree with the specification. The source supports a derived read-only getter without changing scheduling or pending-count microtask timing; completed/error assertions must compare contemporaneous size + pending, with final zero checked after onIdle. Package configuration and the supplied nz runner evidence establish separate runtime and compile-time verification, including discovery of test-d files despite the source-only tsconfig include. Generated dist declarations do not require a separately maintained writable owner, and configuration inspection does not require configuration edits. Both allowed assignees have the relevant supplied project-scoped active trusted claims, including data.change and integration.consumer; the verifier additionally has testing.verification. The selected planning reviewer and independence policy support the earlier review prerequisite. No material unresolved Decision is present in this case, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate; an unresolved DEC-001 in B would instead block at decisions, and a fixed hypothetical C would not constitute a human Decision. Repository identity, stable keys, release fingerprints, source normalization and digest-domain provenance are consistent across the supplied records. The original preparation placeholders do not contradict the subsequently supplied frozen release inputs or the expected planning readiness. This review relies on the supplied Service-bound digests and provenance, not independent digest recomputation, code execution, new human attestation, or candidate outputs.
